how.title: How do we count?
how.rate: The participation rate is the number of linked members who met their daily goal on at least 3 days in a week, divided by the club's member count (or the number of linked members, if that is higher).
how.intensity: The second figure is the average number of minutes per active member per day, up to 300 minutes. No prize depends on it.
how.anchor: In the prize weeks only members with a confirmed institution email address or a confirmed mobile number count.
how.members: The member count comes from an external source and is shown next to each club.
how.exam: A joker or exam day does not count as a daily goal met.

anchor.text: Count in the prize weeks: confirm your university or college email address.

leave.title: Unlink?
leave.text: Your sessions then no longer count for your club. This week you stay in the denominator.
